# Tall Nest Group

> Tall Nest Group is a Pakistani FMCG company, based in Lahore, that builds consumer brands. Its first brand is Jingo, a confectionery range priced from Rs. 5 to Rs. 50. Tall Nest Group is appointing confectionery distributors across Pakistan for Jingo.

## Key facts

- Company: Tall Nest Group (also "Tall Nest Food & Beverages"), DHA Phase 6, Lahore, Pakistan.
- Brand: Jingo — confectionery for children, sold at pocket-money prices.
- Range: 7 categories, 35+ products.
- Pricing: Rs. 5 to Rs. 50 per pack.
- Distribution: recruiting distributors across Pakistan, with exclusive territories.
- Distributor minimum order (MOQ): Rs. 30 million per month.
- Contact for distributors: WhatsApp / phone +92 317 827 6277 (https://wa.me/923178276277), email hello@tallnest.com.

## Jingo categories

- Candies — 9 flavours, Rs. 5 (50 pcs/box, 36 boxes/carton).
- Toffees — 7 flavours, Rs. 5 (50 pcs/box, 36 boxes/carton). Also a Mix Toffees Pouch bulk pack, Rs. 500 (100 pcs/pouch).
- Liquid chocolates (Squizo) — 6 flavours, Rs. 10.
- Lollipops (Twist) — 6 flavours, Rs. 10.
- Bubblegums (Bublo) — 3 flavours, Rs. 10.
- Bunties (Choco Chums) — 1 product, Rs. 5 / Rs. 10.
- Nimkos (Mehfil) — 3 flavours, Rs. 10 / 20 / 50.
